caption: AI advice often sounds confident but skips testing. This carousel shows how to use AI to frame decisions, not crown a winner. Are you using AI to decide or to question? #AIatWork #DecisionMaking #Productivity #Entrepreneurs

slides.title: Let AI Decide Your Idea
slides.body: AI verdicts arrive too soon. Here are five prompts to frame, test, and refine decisions, not final calls.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose risks
slides.body: Prompt: Given idea [IDEA], list five risks with likelihood and impact, score 0-100, and one blind-spot note.

slides.title: 2. Improve clarity
slides.body: Prompt: Translate [IDEA] into 3 testable hypotheses with success metrics and a decision-criterion set for quick checks.

slides.title: 3. Apply scenario tests
slides.body: Prompt: Simulate two realistic future scenarios for [IDEA] and output decision outcomes and warning signals.

slides.title: 4. Check robustness
slides.body: Prompt: Identify dependencies, data gaps, and potential biases in AI recommendations for [IDEA], and propose data needed to verify.

slides.title: 5. Refine with a plan
slides.body: Prompt: Create a two-week test plan for [IDEA] with milestones, metrics, and a rollback rule.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: Takeaway: Treat AI as a decision frame, then validate with small tests and clear criteria.
